Wild Tales Sketch (Vẽ Chuyện Hoang Dã) explains real, fact-checked animal science with funny hand-drawn whiteboard animation. Narration is in Vietnamese: turn on CC and choose Auto-translate for subtitles in your language.

Watch the whole series in order: Animal World playlist on our channel.

#WildTalesSketch #AnimalFacts #WhiteboardAnimation #FunnyAnimals

videos.title: Honey Badger: The 12kg Madman That Takes On 3 Lions & Shrugs Off Cobra Venom! | Ep 1
videos.desc: Lions, hyenas, elephants... forget them. A 12kg animal standing only 30cm tall is listed by Guinness as the most fearless creature on the planet: the HONEY BADGER (Mellivora capensis)! In Episode 1 we break down its survival stats and the 3 biological weapons that let it fight lions and survive a king cobra bite.

videos.title: Sea Otters Decoded: The Doraemon Pocket & 3 Wild Secrets! | Ep 2
videos.desc: The sea otter (Enhydra lutris) has the thickest fur of any animal - about 1 million hairs per square centimeter - and holds hands while sleeping so it doesn't drift away. But behind the cute face hide some wild survival tricks, including a built-in skin pocket for storing food and its favorite rock.

videos.title: Dolphins Decoded: Volleyball With Pufferfish & 3 Crazy Secrets! | Ep 3
videos.desc: Dolphins have one of the biggest brains in the ocean and that famous friendly smile. In Episode 3 we use funny hand-drawn sketches to reveal their amazing biological superpowers - and the strangest games they play in the open sea, including passing a pufferfish around like a volleyball.

videos.title: Platypus Decoded: The 200-Year-Old Hoax & 4 Insane Oddities! | Ep 4
videos.desc: When European scientists first saw a platypus (Ornithorhynchus anatinus) in the 18th century, they were sure it was a prank - a duck's bill sewn onto a mammal. In Episode 4 we reveal the truth: an electric-sensing bill, venomous spurs, fur that glows under UV light, and no stomach at all!

videos.title: Pelicans Decoded: The Beak That Tries To Swallow Everything! | Ep 5
videos.desc: Pelicans will test-bite almost anything that moves - pigeons, big fish, even a capybara's head! In Episode 5 we open up the secrets of this giant water bird: a throat pouch that holds about 13 liters of water, a 3-meter wingspan and some very greedy habits.

videos.title: Survived 5 Mass Extinctions... But Killed By A Snail! | Tardigrade | Ep 6
videos.desc: The tardigrade (water bear) is smaller than a grain of sand, yet it survives -272°C, 150°C, radiation 1,000 times the lethal dose for humans, and even 10 days naked in outer space. And yet a snail can kill it! Right now, thousands of tardigrades may be sleeping on the Moon...

videos.title: A Punch As Hot As The Sun... That Smashes Aquarium Glass! | Mantis Shrimp | Ep 7
videos.desc: The mantis shrimp is shorter than 20cm, but its punch accelerates as fast as a rifle bullet and creates cavitation bubbles that briefly reach about 4,700°C - close to the surface of the Sun! Yet every time it molts, this ocean boxing champion becomes soft as jelly and has to hide in its burrow...

videos.title: Only 15kg But Steals Food From Wolves And Grizzly Bears?! | Wolverine | Ep 8
videos.desc: The wolverine weighs only about 15kg but may have the boldest heart in the animal kingdom: teeth that can crush frozen bone, paws that work like snowshoes, and the nerve to chase a 300kg grizzly bear away from its meal. Meet the fearless warrior of the snow!

videos.title: Pushing Friends Into The Sea To Test For Leopard Seals?! | Penguin | Ep 9
videos.desc: The Adélie penguin is under 70cm tall and weighs about as much as a cat - but today it stands trial with 4 pieces of evidence: stealing pebbles from neighbors, pushing friends into the sea to check for leopard seals, shooting poop up to 1.34 m (Ig Nobel Prize 2005) and slapping scientists! The funniest courtroom in Antarctica - guilty or not guilty?

videos.desc: Koalas have a surprisingly smooth brain, a skull partly filled with fluid, a 2-meter-long caecum that digests toxic eucalyptus leaves, and fingerprints almost identical to ours! Open the funniest medical file in Australia: the strange evolution of the laziest marsupial.

videos.title: A Carnivore's Gut But Chews Bamboo 14 Hours A Day?! | Giant Panda | Ep 11
videos.desc: The giant panda has the digestive system of a meat-eater, yet chews bamboo up to 14 hours a day, absorbs only about 17% of it, poops dozens of times a day, uses a 'sixth finger' to strip bamboo and can only get pregnant during a tiny window each year! Follow 24 hours in the life of Sichuan's vegetarian warrior.
